<thought>Only carbon shows a clear isotopic pattern (M+1 ~8% of base, decreasing M+2, M+3, etc) consistent with natural 13C abundance for ~8 carbons. No other element's characteristic isotope pattern (Cl, Br, S, N, O) is evident. Thus carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
